newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean values firm, corn steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean values firm, corn steady.

text.p: FOB Gulf soybean basis values firmed one cent a bushel in most positions on Friday while corn and wheat values were mostly steady in lackluster activity, dealers said.
"The November 1-20 soybean position traded at 35 cents (a bushel) That is about where the market is," one dealer said.
It is extremely quiet, the dealer said.
In export news, Taiwanese buyers are expected to hold three tenders next week for a total of 72,000 tonnes of corn, 12,000 tonnes of soybeans and between 64,000 tonnes and 96,000 tonnes of wheat.
